reason: short answer over the limits after one retry

text: FAA guidance supports reestablishing control link when a hazard occurs and proceeding with emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link, including following loss-of-VLOS procedures if needed. DJI Matrice 30T manual indicates failsafe can be disabled during RTH when GNSS has fewer than three bars, and that RC loss can set actions to RTH, land, or hover, with automatic RTH after six seconds and RTH returning to the last recorded Home Point; it also notes RTH path display under sufficient lighting and normal vision. Incident reports provide no usable evidence; they are unverified accounts.
